realm-backdrop-a#0.notes: Realm backdrop: sunny meadow #8ab85c, blue sky with two clouds, blue-green hills with a tiny windmill, a dirt road from the bottom, oak trees and fences only at the edges; calm middle for the town; cropped to rows 4-227 like the others

restless-backdrop-a#0.notes: Restless backdrop: violet dusk with a pale moon, slate hills with a far spire, calm ash ground, a stone path, dead trees, tombstones and railings at the edges; spooky-cute, never gory; the white rows at the top and bottom are cropped away (rows 4-227 kept)

horde-backdrop-a#0.notes: Horde backdrop: hazy orange sky, red mesas and smoke plumes, calm red regolith with straw tufts, a dusty track, junk heaps, skulls and a signpost at the edges; the white rows at the top and bottom are cropped away (rows 4-227 kept)

candy-backdrop-a#0.notes: Candy backdrop: pale pink sky fading to mint with chunky clouds, pink and mint gumdrop hills and a tiny sugar-glass castle on the horizon, calm icing-white ground with faint pink shadows and a few sprinkles, a pink frosting path from the bottom, lollipop trees, candy canes and iced gingerbread mounds only at the edges; no provider frame (cropped to rows 4-227 like the others)
